Below is the Disa list for 2012-2013. All plants offered below are divisions from my mother plants and are sent bare-root. Large divisions are flowering sized, medium divisions should reach flowering size within 1.5 years. Shipping and handling is $6 or 15%, whichever is greater. Please send orders to meizzwang@gmail.com Plants can only be sent within the US.


Photos of most plants can be found here: sarracenia.proboards.com/index.cgi?board=orchids&action=display&thread=297 If you see anything that’s not listed, feel free to inquire!

Thanks!
-Mike
